lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Qù yīyuàn. Wǒ shēntǐ bù hǎo.
lines.english: Going to the hospital. My body is not good.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 没事吗？要不要我和你一起去？
lines.pinyin: Méi shì ma? Yào bu yào wǒ hé nǐ yīqǐ qù?
lines.english: No problem? Do you want me to go with you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Méi shì, bú yào. Wǒ yī ge rén qù.
lines.english: No problem, don't want. I'll go alone.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nà màn diǎn zǒu, zǎo diǎn huílái.
lines.english: Then walk slowly, come back early.
